items.body:
# AIP-1: AI Pilot research, experiments and documentation

The first Project task for the independent [AI Pilot repository](https://github.com/fssrepository/ai-pilot). The previous five commits were squashed into one published [`[AIP-1]` commit](https://github.com/fssrepository/ai-pilot/commit/1734b8373561b1a8a4d9d480349e48047ce1edc6). The working tree content is identical to the state before the squash.

## Delivered

- Local Qwen 0.8B model runner and investigation playground with token and attention visualizations.
- Adaptive Llama C++ demonstrator, reproducible campaign and validated results report.
- Repair Graph v1–v3 experiments, protocols, comparison reports and verification traces.
- Context-organized `guides/development`, `guides/learning` and `guides/publication` documentation, with related PDFs and working relative links.

## Measurement

| Metric | Value |
| --- | ---: |
| Tokens, including cached input | **55,517,627** |
| Unique responses | **449** |
| Active task time | **3.297411 hours** |
| Newly allocated portfolio time | **0.223150 hours** |
| Standard API list-price equivalent | **$78.50 estimate** |

Period: 2026-10-11 to 2026-10-27; measurement cutoff: `2026-10-27T18:56:15.654Z`. The source is the selected work intervals from three root conversations; response IDs are counted once. Observed models were `gpt-6-astra / high` and `gpt-6-sol / high`. Task time includes tool and network waits; it is not a record of human labor. **3.074261 hours** of MSC-122 activity overlapping the October 11 AI Pilot period remain allocated to that earlier task, so the new portfolio allocation is smaller than the active time. Tokens come from distinct responses. The price is an estimated Standard API equivalent, not an invoice. The final accounting update after the cutoff is excluded from this frozen measurement.

## Verification and links

The 20 relative-link checks for changed Markdown files and Python syntax compilation passed; `git diff --check` was clean. Previously recorded experimental verification manifests are historical snapshots with old `docs/` paths.
